title: The distance-two graph needs a lower bound on its number of vertices.
details: PDF pp.69–73 define the cyclic distance-two edges {i,i+2 mod n}. At n=1 or n=2 these include loops, whereas the finite graphs under discussion are irreflexive. Restricting this construction to n≥3 repairs the local boundary case. The nondefinability argument uses arbitrarily large orders and is unaffected. The corpus states this restriction and proves distinctness of edge endpoints.
